effects: The signer sends exactly `assets` USDC (0x8335…2913 on Base) to the vault (OZ ERC4626._deposit: safeTransferFrom(caller, this, assets)).
The receiver gets degenUSDC vault shares, floor(assets × (totalSupply+1e12)/(totalAssets+1)) after the performance fee accrues; there is no minimum (MetaMorpho.deposit).
The vault supplies the USDC to Morpho Blue markets in its supply queue (_supplyMorpho); this moves no further signer asset.
formats.shown: "Deposit" with the USDC amount, a raw "Share ticker: degenUSDC" line, and the address that receives the shares.

findings.title: deposit does not show how many shares the receiver gets; the vault computes it from storage.
findings.evidence: MetaMorpho.deposit: `shares = _convertToSharesWithTotals(assets, totalSupply(), newTotalAssets, Math.Rounding.Floor);` No share amount and no minimum are in calldata. The descriptor shows only `Share ticker` = `$.metadata.constants.vaultTicker`.
findings.fix: None possible in ERC-7730. Keep the ticker line, but rename it 'Receive' or 'Shares received in'.

findings.title: deposit labels the vault ticker 'Share ticker', so the signer cannot tell it means the token received.
findings.evidence: descriptor deposit field: {"label": "Share ticker", "format": "raw", "value": "$.metadata.constants.vaultTicker"}. The intent is only "Deposit" and names neither USDC nor the vault.
findings.fix: Rename the label to "Receive shares of" and add an interpolatedIntent such as "Deposit {assets} into degenUSDC for {receiver}".

effects: The signer sends USDC to the vault. The amount is ceil(shares × (totalAssets+1)/(totalSupply+1e12)), set by the vault, and nothing caps it except the signer's allowance (MetaMorpho.mint, ERC4626._deposit).
The receiver gets exactly `shares` degenUSDC vault shares (_mint(receiver, shares)).
The vault supplies the USDC to Morpho Blue (_supplyMorpho).
formats.shown: "Mint" with a raw "Deposit asset: USDC" line, the exact degenUSDC shares minted, and the receiver of the shares.

findings.title: mint does not show how much USDC leaves the signer; the vault computes it from storage.
findings.evidence: MetaMorpho.mint: `assets = _convertToAssetsWithTotals(shares, totalSupply(), newTotalAssets, Math.Rounding.Ceil);` then `_deposit(_msgSender(), receiver, assets, shares)`. The screen shows only `Deposit asset` = "USDC" with no amount.
findings.fix: None possible in ERC-7730. Rename the label to "Pay with (amount set by vault)" so the signer knows an amount leaves.

findings.title: mint intent "Mint" hides that the signer pays USDC for the shares.
findings.evidence: descriptor mint: "intent": "Mint". The code pulls USDC from the signer in ERC4626._deposit: `SafeERC20.safeTransferFrom(_asset, caller, address(this), assets);`.
findings.fix: Change the intent to "Deposit USDC for vault shares" and add an interpolatedIntent "Mint {shares} for {receiver}, paid in USDC".

formats.key: withdraw(uint256 assets, address receiver, address owner)
effects: The vault burns degenUSDC shares from `owner`, ceil(assets × (totalSupply+1e12)/(totalAssets+1)). The signer's shares burn when the signer is the owner (ERC4626._withdraw: _burn(owner, shares)).
When the signer is not the owner, the signer spends that share amount from the owner's allowance to it (_spendAllowance(owner, caller, shares)).
The receiver gets exactly `assets` USDC from the vault (safeTransfer(receiver, assets)), after the vault withdraws it from Morpho Blue (_withdrawMorpho).
formats.shown: "Withdraw" with the exact USDC amount, the receiver as "To", and the share owner.

findings.title: withdraw does not show how many shares burn; the vault computes them from storage, with no cap.
findings.evidence: MetaMorpho.withdraw: `shares = _convertToSharesWithTotals(assets, totalSupply(), newTotalAssets, Math.Rounding.Ceil);` No share amount or maximum is in calldata.

findings.title: withdraw intent "Withdraw" names neither the vault nor that degenUSDC shares burn.
findings.evidence: descriptor withdraw: "intent": "Withdraw". There is no interpolatedIntent. The code burns shares from `owner` in ERC4626._withdraw.
findings.fix: Add an interpolatedIntent such as "Withdraw {assets} from degenUSDC to {receiver}".

formats.key: redeem(uint256 shares, address receiver, address owner)
effects: The vault burns exactly `shares` degenUSDC from `owner`. The signer's shares burn when the signer is the owner; otherwise the signer spends the owner's allowance (ERC4626._withdraw).
The receiver gets USDC, floor(shares × (totalAssets+1)/(totalSupply+1e12)), from the vault, with no minimum (MetaMorpho.redeem, safeTransfer(receiver, assets)).
formats.shown: "Redeem" with the degenUSDC shares, the receiver as "To", and the share owner. Nothing says which asset arrives.

findings.title: redeem never names USDC as the asset the receiver gets.
findings.evidence: MetaMorpho.redeem → ERC4626._withdraw: `SafeERC20.safeTransfer(_asset, receiver, assets);` with _asset = USDC. The redeem fields are only `Shares to redeem`, `To` and `Owner`. The mint format shows `underlyingTicker`, but redeem does not.
findings.fix: Add {"label": "Receive asset", "format": "raw", "value": "$.metadata.constants.underlyingTicker"} and add an interpolatedIntent "Redeem {shares} for USDC to {receiver}".

findings.title: redeem does not show how much USDC arrives; the vault computes it from storage, with no minimum.
findings.evidence: MetaMorpho.redeem: `assets = _convertToAssetsWithTotals(shares, totalSupply(), newTotalAssets, Math.Rounding.Floor);` No minimum is in calldata.

mint(uint256 shares, address receiver).worst: mint intent "Mint" hides that the signer pays USDC for the shares.

redeem(uint256 shares, address receiver,.worst: redeem never names USDC as the asset the receiver gets.

summary.worst: redeem never names USDC as the asset the receiver gets.
